question: The chemical formula of ammonium sulphate is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**(NH4)2SO4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The chemical formula of ammonium sulfate is **(NH4)2SO4**.
 
• Ammonium sulfate is a salt with the chemical formula **(NH4)2SO4**.
 
• It consists of two ammonium ions (NH4⁺) and one sulfate ion (SO4²⁻).
 
• It is widely used as a fertilizer for alkaline soils.
 
• The compound provides essential nutrients like nitrogen and sulfur to plants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ammonium Ions (NH4⁺)**

 
 
• Ammonium ions are positively charged ions derived from ammonia (NH3).
 
• They play a critical role in the nitrogen cycle and are an important source of nitrogen for plants.
 
 
 
• **Sulfate Ion (SO4²⁻)**
 
 
• Sulfate is a polyatomic anion with the empirical formula SO4²⁻.
 
• It is widely found in nature and is an essential nutrient for plants, aiding in amino acid and protein synthesis.
 
 
 
• **Uses of Ammonium Sulfate**
 
 
• Primarily used as a soil fertilizer, providing essential nutrients to crops.
 
• Also used in water treatment, food processing, and as a flame retardant.
 
 
 
• **Properties of Ammonium Sulfate**
 
 
• It appears as a white crystalline solid.
 
• Highly soluble in water and has a salty taste.
